## MONTHLYREPORT

'hie Contractor shall prepare monthly reports and submit to the Contract Administrator before the fifth (5th) day of each month for the previous month. The cut-off date or data date for this report shall be the last calendar day of the month. The monthly report shall essentially be an update of the Programme of Works and weekly report.The format for ihe Monthly Report shall be as described in the following Sub-clauses.The outer cover of the report shall be titled with the following information:

- a) The title of the Project
- b) The Trade Package number and title
- C) The title"Monthly Report for the month of [subject month] (up to [data date]") and a report number in consecutive sequencing.
- d) The name of the Employer "Emaar Misr"
- e) The name of the Contract Administrator "Turner Construction International LLC"
- f) The name of the Engineer The name of the Contractor
